item.title: Glass firm GG revenues flat at £27m amid NI rise - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Liverpool-based national commercial glazing company GG Glass and Glazing blames Government’s National Insurance rise as revenues remain flat at £27m and pre-tax profits fall

item.title: Revenues and profits rocket at Applied Nutrition - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Liverpool city region sports nutrition venture Applied Nutrition reports surge in half-year revenues and pre-tax profits and forecasts full-year revenues of £140m, with new HQ set to push this to £300m

item.title: Property developer joins town’s BID board - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Property developer Paul Halsall joins the board of Southport BID and says he’s eager to play a role in shaping the town’s future success

item.title: Work begins on £80m Parkside phase one - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Work on the first 800,000 sq ft of a 2.4m sq ft Liverpool city region logistics and manufacturing development begins, with phase one costing £80m

item.title: Thriving nursery repays £100,000 investment - Liverpool Business News
item.description: In 2022 fund managers at River Capital backed a Bootle nursery to the tune of £100,000 and now the cash is repaid as the business thrives

item.title: Knowsley pushes forward with town centre plans - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Knowsley Council approves £600,000 for detailed plans on the long-awaited regeneration of Prescot town centre to include new retail accommodation, library and museum as well as space for new homes

item.title: Waiting list as work starts on five-court padel venue - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Work begins to build the latest Liverpool city region padel venue offering five courts with a June opening scheduled and 2,500 people already on the waiting list

item.title: Global maritime firm to move into Liverpool Waters - Liverpool Business News
item.description: Global maritime consultancy Brookes Bell is taking 5,500 sq ft of office space on Liverpool waterfront in a deal with Peel Waters
